mechanism_narrative: The recent sharp and sustained decline in RETAIL_REC mobility, culminating in a significant drop in the most recent week, indicates a strong negative momentum that will continue to drive down retail and recreation activity over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in WORKPLACES mobility, specifically a decline of over 20 points in the most recent week, indicates a widespread shift to remote work, which directly reduces opportunities for retail and recreation during commutes and lunch breaks, leading to further declines.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by more than 20 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not decline further despite WORKPLACES falling by more than 20 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous sharp increase in RESIDENTIAL mobility (over 4 points) and decrease in TRANSIT mobility (over 17 points) signifies a strong stay-at-home directive combined with reduced public transport use, which severely limits discretionary travel for retail and recreation over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises > 4 points AND TRANSIT falls > 17 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days even when RESIDENTIAL rises and TRANSIT falls significantly.

mechanism_narrative: The recent decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility, even for essential services, suggests a broader reduction in all non-home-based activity due to fear or strict measures, which will further depress retail and recreation over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows recovery over the next 28 days despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining low or declining.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp drop in PARKS mobility (over 7 points week-on-week) indicates a general public reluctance to leave home even for outdoor leisure, which will immediately translate to lower retail and recreation activity in the very short term, over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by more than 7 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases in the next 7 days despite a significant drop in PARKS mobility.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous and significant declines across RETAIL_REC, WORKPLACES, and TRANSIT, coupled with a sharp rise in RESIDENTIAL, strongly indicates the implementation of broad government-mandated restrictions or stay-at-home orders, which will continue to suppress retail and recreation for the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows any significant recovery over the next 28 days despite other mobility categories remaining suppressed and residential elevated.

mechanism_narrative: The inverse relationship between a sharp decline in WORKPLACES (over 20 points) and a sharp increase in RESIDENTIAL mobility (over 4 points) indicates a strong shift to working from home, which directly reduces foot traffic for retail and recreation during typical work hours and commutes over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls > 20 points AND RESIDENTIAL rises > 4 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days despite a significant and inverse shift between WORKPLACES and RESIDENTIAL.

mechanism_narrative: A severe reduction in TRANSIT station visits, specifically a decline of over 17 points week-on-week, signals a significant disruption in public transportation usage, which will directly limit access to retail and recreation venues for a substantial portion of the population, leading to further declines over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by more than 17 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite TRANSIT falling by more than 17 points week-on-week.
